To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
e-shopping quality is the most important factor in consumers' adoption decision.

e-shopping quality is an antecedent of consumer perceptions of usefulness, enjoyment, and e-shopping trust; and that e-shopping enjoyment and trust are antecedents of consumer attitudes toward e-shopping.

the quality of the online shopping experience, as measured by web site design, privacy/security, customer service, and the atmosphere/experience of the online shopping environment, has a positive effect on consumer perceptions of usefulness and enjoyment, which, in turn, have a positive effect on attitudes toward online shopping and the intention to shop online.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of e-shopping quality, trust and enjoyment on the consumer's acceptance of online shopping.
how e-shopping quality, trust, enjoyment, and perceived ease of use affect consumers' attitudes toward and behavioral intentions of e-shopping.
how to improve e-shopping adoption by understanding the antecedents of e-shopping quality, usefulness, trust, enjoyment, and attitude toward e-shoping.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

e-shopping quality is the most significant factor in determining consumers' acceptance of e-shopping, and e-shopping quality is a multi-dimensional construct that is comprised of web site design, service quality, privacy/security, as well as atmospheric/experiental quality.
e-shopping quality is an important factor for e-shopping acceptance, and that e-shopping quality consists of web site design, privacy/security, customer service, and atmospheric/experiencial quality.
e-shopping quality, trust and enjoyment are important determinants of consumer e-shopping behavior.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
e-shopping quality, trust and enjoyment are the most important determinants for consumers to adopt and continue to shop online.
the e-shopping quality of a web site has a direct effect on consumers' trust in the web site.
e-shopping quality has an important influence on e-shopping acceptance, and that the influence of quality is not only on usefulness and trust, but also on shopping enjoyment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
e-tailers need to understand the needs of their consumers and provide a shopping experience that is both enjoyable and safe.
e-shopping is not simply about web design and functionality, it is about creating a shopping experience.
e-shopping quality is the foundation of e-shopping acceptance.
